complexity.notes: Re-sorting is unnecessary since the input is already sorted, making the solution O(n log n) instead of the optimal O(n). The multiple nums.index calls and pop-based duplicate handling are unidiomatic and fragile; tracking original indices while scanning would be cleaner.
complexity.summary: Copies and sorts the array, then runs a two-pointer scan to find the pair; original 1-indexed positions are recovered via list.index, with special handling for duplicate values using pop.
